what: On an accent-color panel (top one step lighter, coarse grain) orange guide lines (three vertical · one horizontal · two X diagonals · right >< two) are always laid down, and white lines are drawn and withdrawn like a ruler (the center vertical line shrinks to the height of the horizontal line and opens again) while circles are drawn as if with a compass in a 13.013s loop — one big circle goes once around the center, vanishing and appearing twice, the left circle travels along the diagonal to the lower circle’s spot and back, the upper circle flips once on the vertical axis, and the small circle slips out obliquely, returns from the opposite side, bounces once and settles. Inside the small and left circles three concentric circles shrink in turn. Start and end are the same shape so there is no seam. It is drawn to fit the long side of the panel as a square (video cover) and stops when off screen. With still given, it freezes on a single frame of that second (the sub-page header art slot)

options.loop: Length of one loop (seconds), default 13.013 — the whole scene stretches and shrinks at the same ratio
options.still: A still frame (static image slot) stopped at this second’s scene. With reduced motion, the 4.2s scene
options.offset: Start-time offset (s) so several instances on the same page don’t show the same scene at once, default 0
options.zoom: How many times longer than a square the panel’s long side is drawn, default 1 — the original sub-section header art uses 1.42
options.at: Point on the square that sits at the center of the panel (two numbers from 0 to 1), default 0.5 0.5 — the original sub-section header image uses 0.381 0.625 (the lower part where the X crossing and small circle show)
options.grain: If off, no grain is applied
options.--fx-cl-top · --fx-cl-bottom · --fx-cl-l: Top and bottom background colors, white drafting line color, orange guide line color (via style) — default derived from --kf-accent

note: The canvas sits at the very back (z-index −1) — text and tabs inside the panel stay on top. The original is a 974×974 looping video (mp4, 30fps 390 frames), so it was redrawn with the same composition, length and looping — per frame, the time and direction each line is drawn and retracted, each circle’s center · radius · path · drawn angle · opacity · flip, and the concentric circles’ radius curves were measured and transcribed into a table at 0.2s intervals.

from.where: index.html .am-hero__video (large Hero panel), .am-seminar__video (160px square), footer .am-footer__video (230px) and sub-section header .am-subhead__img use still, zoom and at (a paused single frame, original img_sub-mv01). Original video_motion01.mp4 13.013s autoplay muted loop
